page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 8793
Special Branch Stations 38
Date October 24, 1938.

REPORT

Subject Reported Explosion of Japanese Munition Depot.

Made by D. S. Yamashita Forwarded by C. Crawford. D. I.

With reference to the attached translation from the
"Ta Mei Pao" dated October 19, and the "Morning Leader" dated
October 20, regarding the alleged explosion of a Japanese
munition depot, I have to state that enquiries have been made
among Japanese residents in the vicinity of the Tien Tung An
(天通庵) Railway Station but no information justifying the
newspaper report has been obtained.

Further enquiries made at the Headquarters of the
Japanese Naval Landing Party ascertained from Sub-Lieutenant
Satoh that at about 2 p.m. October 18, some members of the
naval landing party carried out blasting with explosives at
the former site of the Yueh Tung (粤東) Middle School, Sze
Dien Road (水電路), Chapei, which was part of their training
and the press report in question appears to refer to the
detonations carried out in these practices.

D. Kamashita
D. S.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE 25 OCT. 1938）

D. C. (Special Branch).

P. A. to D. C. (Sp. Br.)

（批：24/10）

Commander
Sir
Information
"Jno Robertson
DC(SB)

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特别科登记处
编号 S. B. D. 8793
特别科分站 38
日期 1938年10月24日。

报告

事由 据报日军军火库爆炸。

呈报人 D. S. Yamashita 转呈人 C. Crawford，督察长。

关于附呈的10月19日《大美报》及10月20日《晨导报》有关所谓日军军火库爆炸的译文，本人须陈述如下：经在天通庵火车站附近的日本居民中进行查询，未获得任何能证实报纸报道的信息。

进一步向日本海军陆战队总部查询后，从佐藤少尉处获悉，10月18日下午2时许，部分海军陆战队队员在闸北水电路原粤东中学旧址进行了爆破作业，此系其训练内容之一，而上述新闻报道似乎即指这些演习中进行的爆破。

D. Kamashita
特别科警探

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 1938年10月25日）

副督察长（特别科）。

致副督察长（特别科）助理

（批注：24/10）

指挥官
先生
供参考
"Jno Robertson
副督察长（特别科）

October 19, 1938. （印：COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE） Morning Translation.

Ta Mei Pao and other local newspapers:

EXPLOSION OF JAPANESE MUNITION DEPOT

Several munition depots have been established by the Japanese military in the vicinity of the Japanese Naval Landing Party Headquarters on Kiangwan Road.
At 2.20 p.m. yesterday two loud explosions were heard and flames were noticed emerging from one of the Japanese munition depots.
Japanese troops were detailed to the place with fire engines and ambulances. Considerable loss is believed to have been sustained by the Japanese through these explosions.
Nobody was allowed to enter the area because it was within the Japanese defence perimeter. The cause of the explosions is unknown.

1938年10月19日。（印：总办办公室）晨报译文。

《大美报》及其他本地报纸：

日军军火库爆炸

日军在江湾路日本海军陆战队总部附近设立了数座军火库。
昨日下午2时20分，听到两声巨大爆炸声，并注意到其中一座日军军火库冒出火焰。
日军派遣部队携消防车及救护车赶赴现场。据悉日军在此次爆炸中遭受了重大损失。
由于该区域位于日军防御警戒线内，任何人不得进入。爆炸原因不明。

（批注：Sh Psr / twli / omi / MB）
